title: Story deploy workflow arguments
description: The argument shapes of a Story's deploy. StoryDeployInput is the driver's own story-deploy input; BuiltVersionArgs, StoryDeployFixArgs and DeployMechanismArgs are the arguments the driver sends to the built-version, story-deploy-fix and deploy-mechanism workflows. The built-version and story-deploy-fix workflows run child steps of a step of the Story's step journal, which JournalRef names. The execution-identity keys the lane adds (executionId, supervisorInvocationId) are owned by the execution-identity contract and are not named here, so StoryDeployInput and BuiltVersionArgs admit additional properties.

Composite.description: The composite names that address these shapes (dispatch wire values).

VerifiedStackStatus.description: The CloudFormation stack statuses that count as a verified deploy.

SubjectFolder.description: A subject folder name in archstate.subject_folder form: ASCII, lower-case, runs of characters outside a-z0-9 folded to one hyphen, no hyphen at either end.

PluginRoot.description: The absolute path of an agent-teams-workforce install, with no '//' and no '..'.

StoryRef.description: The Story a deploy works on.

TaskRef.description: One Task, infra or infrastructure child bead of the Story.

BuiltVersionItem.description: One delta item of the Story's detailing; status uses the detailing (recon) contract's status vocabulary.

status.description: A status from the detailing (recon) contract.

script.description: Absolute path of the plugin's scripts/portfolio/depscore.py.

StackStatus.description: One CloudFormation stack's status after a deploy.

DeployFailure.description: The failed deploy step and what it printed.

output.description: The captured tail of the step's output.

RelayRef.description: The relay a workflow runs commands through.

dir.description: The Story's own directory for relay files, the same on every dispatch of the Story.

JournalRef.description: The Story's step journal, the run the driver names, and the step whose child steps the workflow runs.

path.description: Absolute path of the Story's step journal file.

run.description: The name of this run: every journal change the workflow reports carries it.

step.description: The id of the running journal step the workflow performs: its steps are that step's child steps.

StoryDeployInput.description: The driver's own story-deploy input for one Story.

repoPath.description: The Story's repository root, not its worktree.

epicId.description: The nearest Epic ancestor's bead id; empty means none.

storySlug.description: The bead's elab_key without its Story prefix; empty when the prefix is absent.

tasks.description: The Story's child Task, infra and infrastructure beads, sorted by id.

BuiltVersionArgs.description: The arguments of the built-version workflow.

beadId.description: The consumer falls back to story.id.

repoName.description: The basename of the Story's repository root.

StoryDeployFixArgs.description: The arguments of the story-deploy-fix workflow.

beadId.description: The consumer falls back to story.id.

DeployMechanismArgs.description: The arguments of the deploy-mechanism workflow.

beadId.description: The consumer falls back to story.id.

repoPath.description: The Story's repository, not its worktree.
